data.name: rDNS
data.description: Allows clients and administrators to create rDNS PTRs from within SynergyCP.
changelog: rDNS management has moved from an expanding box on the server page to its own dedicated page in both the admin and client portals, reached via a Manage Reverse DNS button on the server page (URL: /hardware/server/:id/rdns). This prepares the UI for upcoming IPv6 rDNS support, where per-server record lists can be large.
